svg.title: US and Hong Kong books, measured apart
svg.desc: Us Book +43.79%, +US$1,091 on US$2,491 (true_principal). Hk Book −50.18%, −HK$53,912 on HK$107,431 (net_principal). Combined −35.72% in USD (mixed). Each return is total P&L (realized + unrealized) divided by the basis named under it; the bases differ and the currencies are not added. Daily total P&L per book from 2026-06-15 to 2026-10-16. Source: dashboard.json on the data plane.
